metas.name: Prisoners
metas.description: Like Gone Girl and Sicario, this is a masterfully directed, high-stakes thriller focusing on the dark depths of human desperation.

metas.name: Ex Machina
metas.description: This matches your interest in intellectual science fiction like The Artifice Girl, exploring the ethical boundaries of AI through intense dialogue.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description: From the director of In Bruges, this film blends dark comedy with devastating emotional complexity and prestige performances.

metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: An интеллектуальная sci-fi that shares the philosophical weight of The Artifice Girl and the grand scale of The Abyss.

metas.name: The Invitation
metas.description: A claustrophobic, slow-burn psychological thriller that echoes the tense, dinner-party atmosphere of My Dinner with Andre but with lethal stakes.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: A gritty, intense crime drama that aligns perfectly with the visceral tension and high-stakes moral ambiguity found in Sicario.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A dark character study of an obsessive protagonist, matching the intense psychological depth of The Master.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description: If you enjoyed the survival horror and gritty realism of 28 Days Later, this film's intense, single-shot action sequences will resonate.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: A prestige horror film with high historical accuracy and atmospheric dread, similar to the tone of The Others.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: A mind-bending, low-budget sci-fi mystery that relies on psychological tension and dialogue, much like Exam and The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: Parasite
metas.description: A premier dark comedy-thriller that offers the social commentary and genre-bending intensity you seem to enjoy.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description: A powerful, emotionally complex mystery-drama from the director of Sicario that demands the viewer's full attention.

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description: An intense, stylistically bold psychological horror that features powerhouse performances similar to Joaquin Phoenix in The Master.

metas.name: 10 Cloverfield Lane
metas.description: A high-tension chamber piece that matches the 'enclosed space' mystery of Exam and the paranoia of The Others.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description: A prestige procedural drama that, like Conclave, focuses on the meticulous details of a high-stakes institutional investigation.

metas.name: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
metas.description: David Fincher's dark, gritty mystery thriller provides the same level of prestige and intensity as Gone Girl.

metas.name: Midsommar
metas.description: A disturbing, brightly-lit horror that shares the psychological intensity and unsettling atmosphere found in Smile 2.

metas.name: Zero Dark Thirty
metas.description: From the director of The Hurt Locker, this film offers a similarly grounded and intense look at modern warfare and intelligence.

metas.name: Burning
metas.description: A slow-burn, prestige psychological mystery that rewards patient viewers with deep emotional complexity and tension.

metas.name: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
metas.description: An unsettling, clinical psychological thriller that matches the dark, off-beat tone of films like Bugonia and The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: Se7en
metas.description: A classic of the dark mystery/crime genre that matches the grim tone and high stakes of your favorite thrillers.

metas.name: Upgrade
metas.description: A sci-fi thriller that combines body horror and high stakes, appealing to fans of 28 Days Later and The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: Grave of the Fireflies
metas.description: Since you appreciate Studio Ghibli’s serious works like The Wind Rises, this is a devastatingly emotional and historical masterpiece.

metas.name: The Prestige
metas.description: A complex, high-stakes mystery that rewards careful attention, matching the puzzle-like nature of Exam.

metas.name: Promising Young Woman
metas.description: A sharp, dark comedy-thriller with high emotional stakes and a challenging narrative, similar to It's What's Inside.

metas.name: Hell or High Water
metas.description: Written by the writer of Sicario, this is a gritty, high-stakes modern crime drama with exceptional character development.

metas.name: Triangle
metas.description: A high-concept psychological thriller and mystery that will appeal to fans of the 'logic puzzle' genre like Exam.

metas.name: A Prophet
metas.description: A gritty, prestige crime drama about survival in prison, matching the intensity and realism of Sicario and The Shawshank Redemption.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: A high-prestige psychological mystery with an oppressive atmosphere that mirrors the tension in The Others.

metas.name: The Handmaiden
metas.description: An intricate, dark, and beautifully shot mystery-thriller that offers layers of complexity and prestige filmmaking.

metas.name: Primer
metas.description: The ultimate intellectual sci-fi puzzle film, perfect for someone who enjoys the dialogue-heavy challenge of The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: Decision to Leave
metas.description: A modern prestige mystery/romance that is visually stunning and narratively complex, appealing to fans of Gone Girl.

metas.name: Manchester by the Sea
metas.description: A deeply serious drama focusing on grief and emotional complexity, matching the weight of The Wind Rises.

metas.name: Wind River
metas.description: Another intense crime thriller from the writer of Sicario, focusing on a grim mystery in a harsh, isolated environment.

metas.name: Birdman
metas.description: A prestige, high-energy drama that uses its technical prowess to enhance a complex psychological character study.

metas.name: Under the Skin
metas.description: An atmospheric, unsettling sci-fi horror that demands attention and offers deep thematic layers, similar to The Master.

metas.name: Moon
metas.description: A character-driven science fiction film that explores identity and isolation with the same seriousness as The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: The Revenant
metas.description: An intense survival drama with high stakes and stunning cinematography, appealing to fans of gritty realism like The Hurt Locker.

metas.name: Talk to Me
metas.description: A modern, high-intensity horror that deals with psychological trauma and high stakes, similar to Smile 2.

metas.name: First Reformed
metas.description: A serious, intense character study of a man in crisis, sharing the philosophical and religious weight found in Conclave.
